home.title: Loom AI · Connecting Intelligence. Crafting Tomorrow.
home.label: Home
home.description: Connect desktop, browser and editor context in one workspace. Explore the Loom AI vision and a preset work-plan demonstration.
home.content: Loom AI envisions connecting context across desktop, browser and editor tools so people and intelligence can collaborate. This site presents the product vision, workspace and exploration plans. Work plans are preset demonstrations.

vision.title: Our Vision · Loom AI
vision.label: Our vision
vision.description: Discover how Loom AI aims to connect tools and context, turning scattered discoveries into clear next steps.
vision.content: Loom AI aims to carry ideas beyond a single window, preserve context across familiar tools and help people find their next step. This describes the product direction; cross-tool automated execution has not been delivered.

workspace.title: Loom Workspace · Preset Work-Plan Demo
workspace.label: Loom workspace
workspace.description: Explore a preset work plan in Loom Workspace. Every Pro demo request checks current access on the server and does not call an AI model.
workspace.content: The workspace presents a preset creative-tool work plan. The Pro demonstration requires sign-in and an active entitlement, checked on the server for every run. It does not call models, create files or take external actions. The introduction is public; profile and paid-feature APIs require server authentication.

pricing.title: Explore Plans · Loom Explore and Loom Pro
pricing.label: Explore plans
pricing.description: Browse with Loom Explore for free. A one-time USD 1.00 Sandbox payment tests Loom Pro access, with no real charge, subscription or automatic renewal.
pricing.content: Loom Explore provides free access to the product vision and workspace introduction. Loom Pro currently uses a one-time USD 1.00 Stripe Sandbox transaction to test purchase, entitlement and refund revocation. It causes no real charge and creates no subscription or automatic renewal. The test amount is not a commercial price.

boundary: This is a product demonstration. Work plans are preset and do not call an AI model. USD 1.00 is used only for a one-time Stripe Sandbox test, not a real charge or a commercial price.
textDescription: A concise overview of four public pages and demonstration limits; no account, order or authentication data.
privateBoundary: This document describes public product information only. It provides no personal data, authentication credentials or paid content.
